llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Bitrise connector wrapper with clear read/write action labeling and no hidden executable payload.

dimensions.detail: The skill's purpose is to operate Bitrise through the OOMOL oo connector, and the documented actions are limited to listing apps, listing builds, retrieving a build, and triggering a build.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger text says to use the skill for any Bitrise request, but the runtime instructions narrow execution to live Bitrise connector schemas and require user confirmation before write or destructive actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single markdown skill with no bundled executable code; it documents a fallback oo CLI install via remote installer only if the CLI is missing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The declared tool access is limited to Bash commands beginning with oo, matching the connector-based purpose rather than broad shell access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Use depends on an OOMOL login and a connected Bitrise account with server-side credential injection, but the skill does not instruct hidden credential collection or background persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this only if you are comfortable using OOMOL as the intermediary for your Bitrise account. Read operations may expose Bitrise app and build data to the connector, and triggering builds can change CI state or consume CI resources, so review write payloads before approval.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The broad Bitrise routing language is real, but it is purpose-aligned for a Bitrise integration and is balanced by action-level write/destructive tags plus explicit confirmation requirements.
